scenes.label: Deskhand for Chrome
scenes.headline: Web tasks, in your own signed-in browser
scenes.text: Deskhand for Chrome. It lets the Deskhand app on your own computer carry out web tasks you ask for, in your signed-in Chrome.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.headline: How it works

nodes.title: You ask
nodes.sub: In the Deskhand app, or by voice

nodes.title: This extension
nodes.sub: Talks only to the app on your own computer

scenes.text: You ask for a task. The Deskhand app on your computer passes the steps to this extension, which carries them out in one Chrome tab. Everything stays on your computer.

scenes.label: 1 · Connect
scenes.headline: Not connected until you connect it
scenes.sub: The popup says so until the Deskhand app is running. Press Connect to start.
scenes.text: After installing, the popup says Not connected. Press Connect, and nothing happens until you approve it on your computer.

scenes.label: 2 · You approve it
scenes.sub: A native Yes or No window. No is selected by default.
scenes.text: A Yes or No window appears on your computer, with No selected by default. Only you can approve it.

scenes.label: 3 · Connected
scenes.headline: Connected, and you can disconnect any time
scenes.sub: One press on Disconnect this browser removes the approval.
scenes.text: Once approved, the popup shows Connected. You can disconnect this browser at any time.

scenes.label: 4 · Its own window
scenes.text: When a task runs, Deskhand uses its own browser window. It never touches your other tabs, and Chrome shows its standard debugging bar the whole time.

scenes.label: 5 · A task, step by step
scenes.text: In the Deskhand app you see each step: open a page, search, look at the links, click. Then the result.

scenes.label: Permissions
scenes.headline: Four permissions, one purpose each

perms.name: debugger
perms.why: Read and operate the one tab a task is working in, only while a task you started runs

perms.name: tabs
perms.why: Find that tab and read its address and title, or open a tab for the task

perms.name: alarms
perms.why: Keep the extension connected to the app on this computer

perms.name: storage
perms.why: Remember that you approved the connection

scenes.text: Four permissions, one purpose each. Debugger, to read and operate the task's tab. Tabs, to find that tab. Alarms, to stay connected. Storage, to remember your approval.

scenes.label: Privacy
scenes.headline: Private by design
points: Talks only to the Deskhand app on your computer
No remote code, no data sold
You approve once, and can disconnect any time
scenes.text: It talks only to the Deskhand app on your own computer. No remote code, and no data is sold. The privacy policy is linked in the listing.
